question: What is the primary purpose of health care financing?

options.A: Eliminating all private pharmacies in the country
options.B: Reducing the number of working nurses in public hospitals
options.C: Generating profits for international pharmaceutical companies
options.D: Raising, pooling, and allocating financial resources for health needs

explanation: Financing ensures that money is collected, grouped, and spent effectively to keep the health system running. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h1)

question: Why is heavy reliance on out-of-pocket payments a major problem for patients?

options.A: It forces sick families to pay directly at the point of care, often causing poverty
options.B: It prevents the government from collecting taxes
options.C: It makes doctors prescribe too many laboratory tests
options.D: It forces hospitals to close down their administrative offices

explanation: Paying cash directly for every service at the hospital door ruins household finances during emergencies. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h1)

question: Which level of health care serves as the first point of contact for a rural community?
explanation: Primary health centers are built right inside communities to handle everyday health needs first. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h2)

question: A patient with a complex heart condition that a local general hospital cannot manage is most likely sent to which level?
explanation: Teaching hospitals and federal medical centers handle advanced and complicated medical cases requiring specialized experts. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h2)

question: What is a main goal of universal health coverage supported by proper funding?

options.A: Building private clinics for wealthy politicians
options.B: Stopping all medical training programs in universities
options.C: Ensuring everyone gets needed health services without financial hardship
options.D: Making all hospital treatments completely free of charge forever

explanation: Universal coverage means health care is accessible to all people without plunging them into debt. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h3)

question: Why is equitable distribution of funds across urban and rural clinics important?

options.A: To prevent rural health collapse and ensure all citizens have access to basic care
options.B: To make sure city hospitals get all the newest vehicles
options.C: To reduce the number of nurses working in rural areas
options.D: To satisfy international organizations without helping patients

explanation: Fair funding stops the concentration of resources only in cities while villages suffer without medicines. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h3)

question: The main reason primary health centers need steady funding is to...

options.B: Build luxury suites for visiting government officials
options.D: Maintain vaccine cold chains and keep basic medicines available

explanation: Grassroots clinics rely on basic supplies and working refrigerators to store vaccines safely. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h4)

question: A rural health clinic receives proper funding and regularly restocks its shelves. What is the most likely result for mothers in that community?

options.B: Higher travel costs to city hospitals
options.C: Fewer visits to the clinic for routine checkups
options.D: Lower rates of maternal and infant mortality during childbirth

explanation: When local clinics have supplies and trained staff, mothers and babies survive routine complications. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h4)

question: Which type of equipment requires heavy capital funding in tertiary hospitals?

options.A: Simple mercury thermometers for home use
options.B: Basic paper record books and wooden furniture
options.C: Advanced diagnostic tools like CT scanners and dialysis machines
options.D: Manual hand fans for patient wards

explanation: Specialized hospitals need expensive, high-tech machines to diagnose and manage complex diseases. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h5)

question: What happens when a tertiary hospital lacks funds to maintain its intensive care unit?

options.A: The hospital starts generating extra revenue from parking fees
options.B: Patients recover faster by relying on natural rest
options.C: Doctors spend more time teaching medical students
options.D: Critically ill patients experience higher mortality due to broken life support systems

explanation: If ICU equipment and oxygen supplies fail from lack of maintenance, vulnerable patients lose their lives. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h5)

question: Which of the following is NOT a direct consequence of health sector underfunding?

options.A: High rates of nurse migration to foreign countries
options.B: Increased risk of hospital-acquired infections for patients
options.C: Abundant supplies of sterile gloves and modern equipment
options.D: Severe staff shortages and heavy workloads for nurses

explanation: Underfunded facilities always suffer from shortages of basic supplies, not abundance. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h6)

question: Why does a severe shortage of nursing staff increase medication errors in a hospital ward?

options.A: Nurses forget how to read prescriptions over time
options.B: Pharmacies stop supplying drugs to overworked units
options.C: Patients refuse to take their drugs unless a doctor gives them
options.D: Rushed nurses juggling too many patients are more likely to miss critical safety steps

explanation: Overworked and exhausted nurses dealing with excessive workloads face a much higher risk of making mistakes. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h6)

question: What is the main function of social health insurance schemes?

options.A: Pooling resources so healthy people help pay for the sick
options.B: Paying salaries exclusively for hospital administrators
options.D: Eliminating all government taxes on food

explanation: Health insurance spreads financial risk by collecting small regular payments from many people to cover the few who fall ill. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h7)

question: Why are public-private partnerships useful in health care financing?

options.A: They remove all financial responsibilities from the government
options.B: They bring in private sector investment and efficiency to improve hospital facilities
options.C: They make medications free for everyone overnight
options.D: They allow private companies to take over nursing schools completely

explanation: Partnering with private investors helps upgrade dilapidated hospital structures and equipment faster than government budgets alone. [learn more](GST322_U4_T2#GST322_U4_T2_h7)
